description: Four LLM endpoints with no rate limiting: a Vercel AI SDK chat route (streamText + gpt-4o), an Express summarize route calling the Anthropic SDK, an Express proxy calling Gemini through Google's current @google/genai SDK, and an AI SDK route using the @ai-sdk/google provider (generateObject + gemini-2.5-pro). Any caller can loop requests and run up the provider bill. VC155 must fire on every handler.
